# SwiftUI Motion Library

> 118 copy-paste SwiftUI motion effects (text, buttons, cards, shapes, loaders, backgrounds, particles and 3D) as small, dependency-free views and modifiers. Effects with large or looping motion respect Reduce Motion.

Use the library API instead of hand-writing these animations. Install with Swift Package Manager:

```swift
// Package.swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library", from: "0.4.0")
// target dependencies
.product(name: "MotionLibrary", package: "SwiftUI-Motion-Library")
```

Then `import MotionLibrary`. Requires iOS 17, macOS 14 or visionOS 1; effects marked iOS 18+ are `@available(iOS 18, macOS 15, visionOS 2, *)`.

In an Xcode app project, add the package with **File → Add Package Dependencies…** rather than editing `project.pbxproj` by hand. To use one effect without the package, copy its source file plus any files listed under "Files" for it (shared helpers such as `Support/Haptics.swift`); every effect compiles from just those files.

## Text

- [Typewriter](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/TypewriterText.swift): Characters appear one by one with a blinking cursor. API: `TypewriterText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Scramble / Decode](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/ScrambleText.swift): Random glyphs resolve into the real text from left to right. API: `ScrambleText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Shimmer](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/Shimmer.swift): A band of light sweeps across text or skeleton placeholders. API: `.shimmer()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Gradient Sweep](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/GradientSweep.swift): A multi-colour gradient flows through the letters forever. API: `.gradientSweep()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Blur-in Words](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/BlurInText.swift): Words come into focus one after another: fade, rise and un-blur. API: `BlurInText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Marquee](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/MarqueeText.swift): Text too long for its line scrolls sideways forever, with faded edges. API: `MarqueeText("…")`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Wave Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/WaveText.swift): Letters bob in a travelling wave, drawn with a TextRenderer. API: `WaveText("…")`. Trigger: Loop. Requires iOS 18+.
- [Count Up](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/CountUpText.swift): A number counts up from zero, and from old to new value on change. API: `CountUpText(value: …)`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Split Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/SplitText.swift): Letters rise into place one after another with a small overshoot. API: `SplitText("…")`. Trigger: Appear / Value change. Requires iOS 18+.
- [Rotating Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/RotatingText.swift): Words take turns: the current one slides up and out as the next rises in. API: `RotatingText([…])`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Glitch](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/Glitch.swift): Every few seconds the view tears: an RGB split, sliced rows and jitter. API: `.glitch()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Circular Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/CircularText.swift): Text wrapped around a circle that slowly turns, like a rotating badge. API: `CircularText("…")`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Focus Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/FocusText.swift): Focus hops from word to word: sharp and bracketed, the rest blurred. API: `FocusText("…")`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Highlighter](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/Highlighter.swift): A marker pen swipes across the text, or underlines it, left to right. API: `.highlighter()`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Morphing Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/MorphingText.swift): Words melt into each other with a gooey, liquid morph. API: `MorphingText([…])`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Neon Flicker](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/NeonFlicker.swift): A glowing neon tube that stutters on and glitches now and then. API: `.neon(color:flicker:)`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Karaoke Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/KaraokeText.swift): A line fills with colour left to right as progress goes from 0 to 1. API: `KaraokeText(_:progress:)`. Trigger: Value change / Scroll.
- [Weight Wave](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/WeightWaveText.swift): Letters swell from thin to black and back in a travelling wave. API: `WeightWaveText(_:)`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Exploding Text](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Text/ExplodingText.swift): Letters blast apart spinning and spring back into place. API: `ExplodingText(_:isExploded:)`. Trigger: Value change / Tap. Requires iOS 18+.

## Button

- [Pressable](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/PressableButtonStyle.swift): Button squashes and darkens on press, then springs back with a light haptic. API: `.buttonStyle(.pressable)`. Trigger: Press. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Tap Ripple](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Ripple.swift): A circular ripple expands from the exact tap location. API: `.ripple()`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Error Shake](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Shake.swift): Horizontal "no" shake for wrong input, triggered by a value change. API: `.shake(trigger:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Magnetic Button](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Magnetic.swift): The button drifts toward a nearby pointer or dragging finger, then springs home. API: `.magnetic()`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Hold to Confirm](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/HoldToConfirmButton.swift): Liquid fills the button while you hold; the action runs only when it's full. API: `HoldToConfirmButton("…") { }`. Trigger: Press. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Loading → Success](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/StatusButton.swift): The button morphs into a spinner, then a green checkmark or a red shake. API: `StatusButton("…", status:) { }`. Trigger: Tap / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `CheckmarkShape.swift`, `Haptics.swift`.
- [Glow Border](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/GlowBorder.swift): A rainbow border runs around the view with a soft glow behind it. API: `.glowBorder()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Shine](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Shine.swift): A slanted glint of light sweeps across the button, on cue or on a beat. API: `.shine(every:) / .shine(trigger:)`. Trigger: Value change / Loop.
- [Jelly](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/Jelly.swift): A rubbery squash-and-stretch wobble on every tap. API: `.jelly(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Click Spark](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/ClickSpark.swift): Short spark lines shoot out from the exact point you tapped. API: `.clickSpark()`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Like Button](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/LikeButton.swift): The heart pops in as a ring bursts open and coloured dots fly out. API: `LikeButton(isLiked:)`. Trigger: Tap. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Animated Symbol](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/AnimatedSymbol.swift): SF Symbols that keep moving: bounce on a beat, pulse, variable colour. API: `AnimatedSymbol("…", style:)`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Liquid Toggle](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/LiquidToggleStyle.swift): A switch whose knob stretches like a drop of liquid as it slides. API: `.toggleStyle(.liquid)`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Gooey Menu](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/GooeyMenu.swift): A round button splits into a fan of buttons like a drop of liquid. API: `GooeyMenu(symbols:action:)`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Slide to Confirm](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/SlideToConfirm.swift): Drag the knob all the way across to run the action; let go early and it springs back. API: `SlideToConfirm(_:action:)`. Trigger: Drag. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Download Button](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/DownloadButton.swift): A capsule shrinks into a progress ring, then pops into a checkmark. API: `DownloadButton(progress:action:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Star Rating](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/StarRating.swift): Stars fill one after another with a springy pop and a burst of sparks. API: `StarRating(rating:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.
- [Bouncy Tab Bar](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Button/BouncyTabBar.swift): A pill glides to the selected tab and its icon squashes and hops. API: `BouncyTabBar(selection:items:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `Haptics.swift`.

## Card & Group

- [Staggered Entrance](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/StaggeredAppear.swift): List items fade and rise into place one after another. API: `.staggeredAppear(index:)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [3D Tilt](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/Tilt.swift): Card tilts in 3D toward the finger with a moving glare, then springs flat. API: `.tiltOnDrag()`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Scroll Reveal](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ScrollReveal.swift): Rows scale up and come into focus as they enter the visible area. API: `.scrollReveal()`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Flip Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/FlipCard.swift): A two-sided card turns over in 3D with a spring. API: `FlipCard(isFlipped:) { } back: { }`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Swipe Card Stack](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/SwipeCardStack.swift): Tinder-style deck: drag the top card away and the pile moves up. API: `SwipeCardStack(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Parallax Carousel](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ParallaxCarousel.swift): Paging cards whose images slide slower than the cards, for depth. API: `ParallaxCarousel(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Expandable Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ExpandableCard.swift): Tap the header and the card springs open, un-blurring its detail. API: `ExpandableCard(isExpanded:) { } detail: { }`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Hero Expand](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/HeroGrid.swift): A thumbnail grows into a full detail card, morphing with matchedGeometryEffect. API: `HeroGrid(items) { thumbnail } detail: { }`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Spotlight Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/Spotlight.swift): A soft glow follows the pointer across the card, like a torch. API: `.spotlight()`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Magnifying Dock](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/MagnifyingDock.swift): Icons swell as the pointer passes over them, like the macOS Dock. API: `MagnifyingDock(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Jiggle](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/Jiggle.swift): The home-screen edit-mode wiggle, each item slightly out of step. API: `.jiggle(isActive:)`. Trigger: Loop / Value change.
- [Fan Stack](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/FanStack.swift): A pile of cards fans out like a hand of playing cards, and gathers back. API: `FanStack(items, isSpread:) { item in }`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Scratch Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ScratchCard.swift): Rub away a scratch-off cover to reveal what's underneath. API: `.scratchToReveal(_:onReveal:)`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Stacking Cards](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/StackingCards.swift): Cards stick at the top while scrolling and shrink as the next one covers them. API: `.stackingCard()`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Deck Shuffle](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/DeckShuffle.swift): A deck splits in two, mixes, and springs back into a messy stack. API: `DeckShuffle(_:trigger:content:)`. Trigger: Value change / Tap.
- [Looping Carousel](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/LoopingCarousel.swift): A paging carousel that wraps around forever, with peeking neighbours. API: `LoopingCarousel(_:autoplay:content:)`. Trigger: Drag / Loop.
- [Drag to Dismiss](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/DragToDismiss.swift): Fling a card away; it flies off with your throw or springs back. API: `.dragToDismiss(isPresented:)`. Trigger: Drag.
- [Shrinking Header](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ScrollHeaders.swift): The header sticks to the top and shrinks as content scrolls under it. API: `.shrinkingHeader()`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Stretchy Header](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Card/ScrollHeaders.swift): A header image stretches when pulled down and drifts with parallax when scrolled. API: `.stretchyHeader()`. Trigger: Scroll.

## Shape

- [Pulse Rings](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/PulseRings.swift): Concentric rings expand and fade continuously, like a radar or live dot. API: `PulseRings()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Like Burst](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/Burst.swift): Particles fly outward from the centre when a value changes. API: `.burst(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Checkmark Draw](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/AnimatedCheckmark.swift): A success mark draws itself: circle stroke, fill, then a popping check. API: `AnimatedCheckmark(isChecked:)`. Trigger: Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `CheckmarkShape.swift`.
- [Confetti](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/Confetti.swift): Confetti bursts out of the view, tumbles under gravity and fades. API: `.confetti(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Loaders](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/MotionLoader.swift): Five looping activity indicators: spinner, dots, bars, orbit and pulse. API: `MotionLoader(.spinner)`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Morphing Blob](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/MorphingBlob.swift): An organic, lava-lamp blob whose outline never stops changing. API: `MorphingBlob()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Draw On](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/DrawOn.swift): Any Shape strokes itself on like a pen, and erases back. API: `Shape.drawOn()`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Progress Ring](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/ProgressRing.swift): A gradient ring springs to each value as the percentage rolls. API: `ProgressRing(progress:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Skeleton](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/Skeleton.swift): A shimmering placeholder of the view's own layout while it loads. API: `.skeleton(isLoading:)`. Trigger: Loop / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `Shimmer.swift`.
- [Sliding Tabs](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/SlidingTabs.swift): A segmented control whose pill or underline glides to the selection. API: `SlidingTabs([…], selection:)`. Trigger: Tap.
- [Reading Progress](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Shape/ReadingProgress.swift): A bar along the top fills as you scroll through the content. API: `ReadingProgressScrollView { … }`. Trigger: Scroll.

## Background

- [Aurora](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/AuroraBackground.swift): Soft, blurred colour blobs drift slowly behind your content. API: `AuroraBackground()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Mesh Gradient](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/AnimatedMeshGradient.swift): A 3×3 MeshGradient whose points drift so the colours flow like liquid. API: `AnimatedMeshGradient()`. Trigger: Loop. Requires iOS 18+.
- [Retro Grid](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/RetroGrid.swift): A synthwave floor: a perspective grid scrolling toward you. API: `RetroGrid()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Border Beam](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/BorderBeam.swift): A short comet of light runs around the card's border forever. API: `.borderBeam()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Waves](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/WaveBackground.swift): Layered sine waves roll across the bottom, back layers slower and paler. API: `WaveBackground()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Film Grain](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/Grain.swift): Flickering film grain over any view, from a tiled noise texture. API: `.grain()`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `SeededRandom.swift`.
- [Flashlight](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/Flashlight.swift): The view goes dark except a soft circle of light around the pointer. API: `.flashlight()`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Lava Lamp](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/LavaLamp.swift): Soft blobs drift up and down, stretching and merging like hot wax. API: `LavaLamp()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Matrix Rain](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/MatrixRain.swift): Columns of glyphs rain down with bright heads and fading trails. API: `MatrixRain()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Interactive Dot Grid](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/InteractiveDotGrid.swift): A grid of dots scatters away from your finger and eases back. API: `InteractiveDotGrid()`. Trigger: Drag / Hover / Loop.
- [Meteors](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/Meteors.swift): Meteors streak across a starry sky with glowing heads and fading tails. API: `Meteors()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Flow Field](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Background/FlowField.swift): Generative curves follow a shifting vector field with dashes flowing along them. API: `FlowField()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Number

- [Rolling Number](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/RollingNumber.swift): Digits roll like an odometer when the value changes. API: `RollingNumber(value:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Split-Flap Display](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/SplitFlap.swift): Characters flip through the alphabet like an airport departures board. API: `SplitFlapText(_:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Slot Machine](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/SlotMachineNumber.swift): Number reels spin with motion blur and land one after another. API: `SlotMachineNumber(value:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Price Ticker](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/PriceTicker.swift): Digits roll to the new price as the background flashes green or red. API: `PriceTicker(value:)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Animated Chart](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/AnimatedChart.swift): Bars grow up one after another; a line draws itself left to right. API: `GrowingBarChart(values:) / DrawingLineChart(values:)`. Trigger: Appear / Value change.
- [Needle Gauge](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Number/NeedleGauge.swift): A speedometer needle swings to the value, overshoots and settles. API: `NeedleGauge(value:)`. Trigger: Value change.

## Particle & 3D

- [Particle Field](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/ParticleField.swift): Drifting particles linked by faint lines, like a living constellation. API: `ParticleField()`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `SeededRandom.swift`.
- [Starfield](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Starfield.swift): Stars stream out of the centre and stretch into streaks: warp speed. API: `Starfield()`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `SeededRandom.swift`.
- [Cover Flow](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/CoverFlow.swift): Side items turn away in 3D, shrink and dim; the centre faces you. API: `CoverFlow(items) { item in }`. Trigger: Scroll.
- [Float 3D](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Float3D.swift): The view hovers: a gentle bob, a slow 3D sway and a breathing shadow. API: `.float3D()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Fireworks](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Fireworks.swift): Rockets climb and burst into rings of falling, fading sparks. API: `Fireworks()`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `SeededRandom.swift`.
- [Snowfall & Rain](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Snowfall.swift): Drifting, swaying snowflakes or fast slanted rain, with depth. API: `Snowfall(.snow / .rain)`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `SeededRandom.swift`.
- [Floating Reactions](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/FloatingReactions.swift): Live-stream style emoji float up, swaying, every time you react. API: `.floatingReactions(trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Warp Tunnel](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/WarpTunnel.swift): Rings rush out of the vanishing point toward you: flying down a tunnel. API: `WarpTunnel()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Holographic Card](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Holographic.swift): A trading card that tilts toward you with a rainbow foil and moving glare. API: `.holographic()`. Trigger: Hover / Drag.
- [Physics Emoji](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/PhysicsEmoji.swift): Emoji tumble in with gravity, bounce off each other and pile up. API: `PhysicsEmoji(trigger:)`. Trigger: Value change / Tap.
- [Shatter](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Shatter.swift): The view breaks into triangular shards that fly, spin and fall away. API: `.transition(.shatter)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [3D Cube](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/CubeTransition.swift): Views swap by turning a cube: one face folds away as the next rotates in. API: `.transition(.cube)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Dot Globe](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/DotGlobe.swift): A globe of evenly spread dots spins on a tilted axis, with pulsing cities. API: `DotGlobe()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Bubbles](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Bubbles.swift): Soap bubbles rise and wobble with rainbow rims and glossy highlights. API: `Bubbles()`. Trigger: Loop.
- [Fireflies](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Particle/Fireflies.swift): Glowing fireflies drift lazily and blink on their own rhythms. API: `Fireflies()`. Trigger: Loop.

## Transition

- [Iris](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/MaskTransitions.swift): A circle opens from a point to reveal the view, like a camera iris. API: `.transition(.iris)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Blinds](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/MaskTransitions.swift): Horizontal slats open together to reveal the view, like Venetian blinds. API: `.transition(.blinds)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Clock Wipe](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/MaskTransitions.swift): A wedge sweeps clockwise from twelve o'clock, like a clock hand. API: `.transition(.clockWipe)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Pixel Dissolve](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/MaskTransitions.swift): The view appears and vanishes in square pixels, in random order. API: `.transition(.dissolve)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Poof](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/StyleTransitions.swift): The view puffs away like smoke: it swells and blurs out. API: `.transition(.poof)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Swoosh](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/StyleTransitions.swift): The view whooshes in leaning forward, with a motion blur. API: `.transition(.swoosh)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Film Exposure](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/StyleTransitions.swift): The view develops like a photo, from over-exposed white to full colour. API: `.transition(.filmExposure)`. Trigger: Appear.
- [Circular Reveal](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/CircularReveal.swift): New content spreads out in a circle from where you tapped. API: `CircularReveal(value:origin:content:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change.
- [Liquid Swipe](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/LiquidSwipe.swift): The next page pours in from the edge behind a bulging liquid wave. API: `.transition(.liquidSwipe)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Page Turn](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/PageTurn.swift): The old page swings away like a book page, revealing the next one. API: `.transition(.pageTurn)`. Trigger: Value change.
- [Glitch Transition](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/GlitchTransition.swift): The view breaks up like a bad signal on its way in or out. API: `.transition(.glitch)`. Trigger: Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `GlitchSlice.swift`.
- [Origami Fold](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionLibrary/Transition/OrigamiFold.swift): The view folds up into creased panels like a paper map. API: `.transition(.origami)`. Trigger: Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `GlitchSlice.swift`.

## Shader

- [Water Ripple](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/WaterRipple.swift): A real ripple distorts the view's pixels outward from a tap. API: `.waterRippleOnTap() / .waterRipple(at:trigger:)`. Trigger: Tap / Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `WaterRipple.metal`.
- [Pixellate](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/Pixellate.swift): The view melts into a mosaic of square blocks and back. API: `.pixellate(_:)`. Trigger: Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `Pixellate.metal`.
- [Chromatic Aberration](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/ChromaticAberration.swift): Red and blue split sideways like a cheap lens; animate it on a beat. API: `.chromaticAberration(_:)`. Trigger: Value change / Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `ChromaticAberration.metal`.
- [CRT Screen](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/CRT.swift): Curved glass, scanlines, a rolling band and flicker, like an old monitor. API: `.crtScreen()`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `CRT.metal`.
- [Heat Haze](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/HeatHaze.swift): The view shimmers like hot air over a desert road. API: `.heatHaze(strength:)`. Trigger: Loop. Copying it without the package also needs `HeatHaze.metal`.
- [Noise Dissolve](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/blob/main/Sources/MotionShaders/NoiseDissolve.swift): The view burns away in organic blotches with a glowing edge. API: `.noiseDissolve(_:) / .transition(.noiseDissolve)`. Trigger: Value change. Copying it without the package also needs `NoiseDissolve.metal`.

## Reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/main/llms-full.txt): usage, implementation notes and full source of every effect
- [motion-catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/main/Docs/motion-catalog.json): the same data as JSON
- [MCP server](https://github.com/BigTsung/SwiftUI-Motion-Library/tree/main/mcp): search effects and fetch their code from any MCP client
